web.title: Odds | API 3.0 - Sportmonks
web.description:
# API FAQ
### Data and coverage
#### How often is data updated?
* Scores: typically updated within 10 seconds of a goal.
* Events and statistics: updated every 30–60 seconds.
* In-play odds: updated every 2–10 seconds.
...
### Odds
#### How do Standard and Premium Odds differ?
Premium Odds is supplied in partnership with TXOdds and includes opening prices and subsequent price changes.
...
#### How quickly do odds update?
Standard pre-match prices typically refresh every 1–10 minutes; Premium pre-match prices around every minute.
In-play updates typically take 2–10 seconds.
Refresh frequency is separate from the delay between a bookmaker changing a price and that change reaching the API.
The previous odds FAQ described delivery delays of up to 20 minutes for Standard pre-match, 20 seconds for Standard in-play and two minutes for Premium pre-match.
These are indicative feed expectations, not guaranteed maximums or an SLA; actual delay varies by bookmaker, event and feed.
...
#### When do odds become available?
Standard Bet365 and Premium prices can appear about three weeks ahead; other Standard bookmakers typically about two weeks ahead.
Timing varies by bookmaker and event.
...
#### How does Premium Odds history work?
Opening prices and subsequent changes remain accessible until seven days after the fixture's `starting_at` time.

web.title: Markets | API 3.0 - Sportmonks
web.description:
The Markets endpoints let you look up market IDs and names before requesting odds.
Availability depends on the feed, bookmaker, league and fixture.
...
The Premium markets directory supports pagination and sorts results by `id`.
Use `order=asc` or `order=desc` and keep the same order and page size while retrieving the directory.
```
GET https://api.sportmonks.com/v3/odds/markets/premium?api_token={{apiToken}}&per_page=50&page=1&order=asc
...
Use the `odds` namespace:
```
https://api.sportmonks.com/v3/odds/markets
```
Authenticate requests with your API token.
...
It includes the source's Standard pre-match, Standard in-play and Premium availability columns.
Availability can change and is not guaranteed for every bookmaker or fixture.
Standard in-play odds are available for bet365 only.
Premium supplies pre-match odds without additional in-play data.
**Combined with Standard** is the source label for coverage obtained by combining the feeds; it does not mean Standard data is automatically returned by a Premium request.
Use `include=odds` for Standard and `include=premiumOdds` for Premium on fixtures.

web.title: Pre-Match vs In-Play Betting Data Pipelines - Sportmonks
web.description:
For standard Football API odds, the main endpoint is:
```
GET /v3/football/odds/pre-match
```
For one fixture:
```
GET /v3/football/odds/pre-match/fixtures/{fixture_id}
...
For products that need deeper pre-match bookmaker coverage, our Premium Odds Feed is separate from the standard in-play feed.
The current Premium feed provides prices from 120+ bookmakers across 42 betting markets.
Premium pre-match odds are updated around every minute, and entries include a bookmaker-update timestamp so freshness can be measured directly.
The dedicated fixture endpoint is:
```
GET /v3/football/odds/premium/fixtures/{fixture_id}
```
...
Premium Odds also records opening prices and subsequent changes, with price history retained for up to seven days after kickoff.
...
It is important not to confuse this with an in-play archive.
Premium Odds is a pre-match product.
For prices while the fixture is being played, use the standard in-play odds feed.
...
Once a fixture starts, the problem changes.
The application now needs current match state and current in-play prices.
Sportmonks exposes in-play odds through:
```
GET /v3/football/odds/inplay
```
For one fixture:
```
GET /v3/football/odds/inplay/fixtures/{fixture_id}
```
For example:
```
curl --request GET \
--url "https://api.sportmonks.com/v3/football/odds/inplay/fixtures/{fixture_id}?api_token=YOUR_TOKEN&include=market;bookmaker"
...
Sportmonks also exposes:
```
GET /v3/football/odds/inplay/latest
```
This endpoint returns in-play odds updated within the previous 10 seconds.
...
– Your backend polls Sportmonks.
– Your backend normalises the relevant fixtures and odds.
– Your trading or pricing service processes them.
– Your application stores the latest approved price state.
...
Our standard Football API includes both pre-match and in-play odds.
The Premium Odds Feed expands the pre-match side with 120+ bookmakers, 42 markets, opening prices and odds history.
If your product needs deeper bookmaker comparison or line-movement analysis before kickoff, Premium is the relevant feed.
If your product needs current prices during the match, use the standard in-play odds feed.
...
Standard in-play odds are the feed to use once the fixture is live.
...
Our Sports Betting API combines pre-match and in-play odds, fixture data, modelled probabilities and settled results in one Football API ecosystem.
